result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code path as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. I only checked that the `cli` module compiles. I didn't run tests, and I didn't run either command or `-help` to see the output.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION`. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is also listed in the no-argument usage overview, using the landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch now accepts either name. `-help` prints the usage of whichever name you typed, so `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Commands" section. It lists `analyzeLandscape` as the documented name and `updateLandscape` as the older name that still works.

I did not commit anything.
